description: Free. Create a new AwesomeVideo API key, no sign-in (0 paid credits; while the free trial runs, 10 welcomeCredits that pay only caption_video and transcribe, jobs up to 2 min, valid 30 days, once per network per day; welcomeCreditsReason says why when 0). Works without a key. Returns the token once; store it and send it as Authorization: Bearer <token> on the MCP connection or REST calls. Paid tools then return 402 with a checkoutUrl ($5 = 500 credits, 1 credit = 1 cent). Limited to a few keys per network per day. The result has firstJob: next call caption_video with a public sourceUrl to caption a video in one step.
